contexts.text: Whence earnest thou, and whither goest thou? () = instruction concerning the state.
Whence are you? () = from what origin.
who are these, and whence came they? () = what their quality is and what their quality has been. Explained. See AR 376.

That to read the Word, and be instructed from it, is of no avail for salvation, unless we live according to it, is signified by, I know ye not whence ye are; depart from Me, ye workers of iniquity ().
